feeds.title: Yoga District Blog
feeds.description: Yoga District is affordable, top-rated training that focuses on a wide variety of yoga styles, inclusivity, and trauma sensitivity. Their trainees are prepared to lead students through both set sequences from major yoga traditions as well as creative sequences of their own. Visit their blog and learn more about their services, training, articles, classes, and more.

feeds.title: Krista Mason Movement Blog
feeds.description: Krista Mason is a Washington DC-based yoga and fitness instructor, and believes in the power of yoga and fitness to change lives for the better. She sees her goal as helping her clients gain strength and stamina on the outside and on the inside. Dive into her blog and learn more about her classes, workshops, retreats, and much more.

feeds.title: Flow Yoga Center Blog
feeds.description: Flow Yoga Center is on a mission to uplift people's lives and brighten their world from the inside out - through warm-hearted human connection and inspired classes led by a world-class teaching team. They have their very own happiness team dedicated to dreaming up ways to infuse magic into every moment you spend with them. Their focus is on fostering a body-positive, welcoming, and diverse community. Check out their blog and learn more about their services, classes, training, offers, pricing, and more.

feeds.title: Beth Kaplan Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Beth Kaplan Yoga Blog is owned and managed by Beth who lives in Washington, DC with her husband Bob and their kittens Oliver and Maple. She teaches yoga classes and offers private sessions, and is currently in training to become a certified yoga therapist. Check out her clog and learn more about sessions, classes, training, schedules, and more.

feeds.title: Yoga With Bara Blog
feeds.description: Yoga With Bara is a Yoga Alliance-certified teacher offering movement and meditation classes that focus on alignment, strength, and the healing aspects of yoga. Her group classes are appropriate for all levels of yoga practitioners, especially beginners and those over forty. Take a walk through her blog and learn more about her techniques, classes, offerings, workshops, articles, and more.

feeds.title: Breathing Space Blog
feeds.description: Breathing Space supports healthy families through yoga and wellness education for all ages. Their yoga instructors incorporate training from many different styles and schools of yoga but all share a love for the practice and a passion for sharing it with yogis of all ages. Get into their blog and learn more about their resources, classes, training, camps, prenatal and postnatal yoga, parenting and breastfeeding support, infant massage, and more.

feeds.title: Karuna Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Karuna Yoga is rooted in the belief that this is the highest calling of all yogis and that people should be their first and highest priority. It offers challenging, but compassionate studio classes in addition to private and corporate sessions. Visit their blog and learn more about workshops, retreats, classes, articles, schedules, and more.

feeds.title: Francesca Cervero Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Francesca Cervero is incredibly passionate about bringing the benefits of yoga to her fellow over-achievers in a way that is accessible, helpful, and meaningful. She provides private yoga and wellness sessions in NYC and Washington DC. Check out her blog and learn more about classes, podcasts, articles, techniques, testimonials, and more.
